title: Museums catching World Cup fever
description: As World Cup teams head into the final stretch of the tournament, museums around the country are seizing on the renewed interest in soccer. There are special exhibits that explain aspects of the game that might surprise you. Bradley Blackburn reports.

title: Training World Cup fans on how to perform CPR
description: As the World Cup continues, the American Heart Association has a big goal of its own: to save lives with simple CPR training. Bradley Blackburn reports.

description: Facing threats from Russia and China, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is breaking with World War II-era limits on security.

title: It’s the Scent of Manure to Most, but ‘the Smell of Money’ to Them
description: The Netherlands has been trying to figure out what to do with manure it can no longer use thanks to environmental rules. Volatile fertilizer costs may help.
